key.name: pill-style
key.description: Visual style when docked at the top edge: 'floating' or 'notch'.

key.name: topbar-collision-mode
key.description: Behavior when GNOME Top Bar is visible: 'drop-below', 'hide-idle', or 'overlay'.

key.name: top-margin
key.description: Vertical offset from the top bezel (or below Top Bar when dropped).

key.name: hide-in-fullscreen
key.description: If true, BayIsland hides during fullscreen windows; if false, high-priority transient alerts still appear.

key.name: show-idle-pill
key.description: Legacy fallback dot when Idle Grab Bar is disabled.

key.name: idle-handle-enabled
key.description: Display an unobtrusive thick pill line at top-center when idle so BayIsland can be hovered or clicked anytime.

key.name: idle-hover-peek
key.description: Morph the idle grab bar into a compact status peek pill when hovered.

key.name: idle-hover-dwell-ms
key.description: Delay before expanding idle bar on hover to prevent accidental triggers near HideTopBar.

key.name: openbar-color-sync
key.description: Read OpenBar accent and pill palette settings when OpenBar is active.

key.name: accent-color
key.description: Solid accent hex color used for active tabs, tiles, controls, and indicators when OpenBar Sync is off or unavailable.

key.name: enable-osd
key.description: Intercept GNOME OSD events (volume, brightness, mic mute, caffeine) into BayIsland.

key.name: enable-mpris
key.description: Display active media playback and interactive controls inside BayIsland.

key.name: mpris-hide-delay
key.description: Seconds to keep paused media visible before collapsing (0 disables auto-collapse while paused).

key.name: enable-privacy
key.description: Show live camera and microphone active indicators.

key.name: enable-notifications
key.description: Display incoming notifications smoothly inside BayIsland while keeping notification history intact.

key.name: notification-duration
key.description: Milliseconds to display incoming notification banners before dismissing.

key.name: enable-power
key.description: Animate AC plug/unplug and low battery alerts.

key.name: enable-timer
key.description: Enable countdown timer and Pomodoro counter inside BayIsland.

key.name: enable-resource-spike
key.description: Warn when sustained CPU or RAM usage exceeds threshold.

key.name: resource-cpu-threshold
key.description: Sustained CPU percentage threshold to trigger a warning.

key.name: resource-ram-threshold
key.description: Sustained RAM percentage threshold to trigger a warning.

key.name: enable-dbus-service
key.description: Expose org.bayisland.Shell on session D-Bus for Terminal Task Done and custom scripts.

key.name: enable-clipboard
key.description: Record clipboard text history with favorites, search, and click-to-paste inside BayIsland.

key.name: clipboard-auto-paste
key.description: Synthesize paste keystroke after copying a clicked clipboard history item into the active window.

key.name: clipboard-paste-shortcut
key.description: Keystroke synthesized for auto-paste: 'shift-insert' (works in GUI apps and terminals) or 'ctrl-v'.

key.name: clipboard-ignore-passwords
key.description: Skip entries tagged with password-manager privacy MIME hints (x-kde-passwordManagerHint).

key.name: clipboard-max-items
key.description: Maximum number of unpinned clipboard history items retained on disk.

key.name: enable-shelf
key.summary: Enable Drag and Drop File Shelf
key.description: Stage temporary files via Wayland drag-and-drop bridge or instant clipboard file copy.

key.name: shelf-drag-reveal
key.summary: Auto-Reveal Drop Zone When Dragging Files
key.description: Expand BayIsland into a Drop Catcher when dragging files near the top-center zone.

key.name: shelf-screenshot-auto-stash
key.description: Automatically stage newly saved GNOME screenshots into the Shelf tab for instant drag/paste.

key.name: enable-quick-actions
key.summary: Enable Quick Actions and Calendar Hub
key.description: Enable Clock, Calendar, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Night Light, DND, and Screenshot controls inside Home tab.

key.name: tab-order
key.description: Display order of the 5 expanded hub tabs: home, media, power, clipboard, and shelf.

key.name: expanded-default-tab
key.description: Default tab when opening BayIsland: 'auto', 'home', 'media', 'power', 'clipboard', or 'shelf'.

key.name: toggle-expand-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to toggle the BayIsland expanded hub.

key.name: quick-timer-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open Home tab timer controls.

key.name: quick-clipboard-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open BayIsland directly to the Clipboard History tab.

key.name: quick-shelf-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open BayIsland directly to the Drag and Drop Shelf tab.
